_readme: Every figure below was read off the cited official page during the 2026-11-09 session. Nothing here is estimated, interpolated or recalled from memory. If a value could not be read off an official page it is null and the row is flagged.

anchor.boc_units: CNY per 100 units of foreign currency
anchor.note: The customer buys USD from the bank, so the relevant published price is the bank's 现汇卖出价 (spot selling rate) = CNY 669.19 per 100 USD, i.e. CNY 6.6919 per USD. The BOC 中行折算价 (671.88) is the bank's own reference price and is NOT a price any customer transacts at.

derived.note: These three spreads answer the same question against three different reference prices. Only the BOC-reference spread (0.4004%) is a like-for-like bank comparison on the same day; the PBOC and Federal Reserve figures are different days and must not be presented as the exact cost of one transaction.

boc_outward_wire.note: Published 2014-11-01 tariff still shown on boc.cn. Head-office tariff; branches may differ ('按照协议或当地公示的内容收取'). No FCC/全额到账 fee and no correspondent fee is published on this page.

convenience_quota_usd_per_person_year.reading: SAFE states this is a 便利化额度 (simplified-processing amount), explicitly 'not the limit' on purchases; above it, genuine current-account purchases need transaction evidence but face no amount ceiling.

tax_record_filing_usd_trigger.reading: A single outward payment of more than the USD 50,000 equivalent for services/income/current transfers to an overseas individual requires a 税务备案表 from the tax authority. This is a filing, not a tax.

sha_branch_approval_limit_rmb.reading: At or below RMB 500,000 the local SAFE branch decides; above it the file goes to SAFE headquarters. Converted at the 2026-11-09 BOC rate this is USD 74,717.

sha_single_remittance_allowance_rmb.reading: RMB 200,000 or less may be remitted in one go; above it the phased schedule applies (50% first, half the remainder after one year, the rest after two years).

form_3520_foreign_gift_usd.reading: Aggregate gifts/bequests above USD 100,000 in a tax year from a nonresident alien or foreign estate must be reported on Form 3520 Part IV. Reporting only.

fbar_aggregate_usd.reading: Aggregate foreign financial accounts above USD 10,000 at any time in the calendar year must be reported.

form_8938_single_living_in_us_usd.reading: Unmarried specified individual living in the U.S.: more than USD 50,000 on the last day of the year, or more than USD 75,000 at any time.

fbar_non_willful_max_usd.reading: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i), maximum for penalties assessed on or after 2025-01-17.

fbar_willful_max_usd.reading: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I), maximum for penalties assessed on or after 2025-01-17; the statute makes the penalty the greater of this amount or 50% of the balance.

form_8938_failure_max_usd.reading: Up to USD 10,000 for failure to disclose plus USD 10,000 for each 30 days of continued non-filing after notice, stated as a potential maximum of USD 60,000.

form_3520_6039f_pct_per_month.reading: 5% of the foreign gift per month the failure continues, capped at 25%; reasonable cause exception available.

prc_evasion_max_pct.reading: State Council Order 532 Art. 39 (逃汇): fine up to 30% of the amount, or 30%-to-100%-equivalent if serious. Art. 40 (非法套汇) carries the same range.

prc_illegal_fx_trading_max_pct.reading: Art. 45 (私自买卖外汇/变相买卖外汇/倒买倒卖/非法介绍买卖): warning, confiscation of gains, fine up to 30%.

prc_cash_carry_max_pct.reading: Art. 42: warning plus fine up to 20% of the amount for illegal carriage of foreign currency across the border.

prc_pit_property_transfer_pct.reading: IIT Law Art. 3(3): proportional rate of 20% on property transfer income, interest, dividends, rent and incidental income. Art. 6(5): taxable base is proceeds minus original value minus reasonable expenses — so the 20% is on the gain, not on the principal.
